requirements.title: Events that cause variables to become defined are enumerated
requirements.definition: The listed non-coarray execution, association, allocation, input/output, and initialization events cause the identified variables, subobjects, storage units, pointers, or construct entities to become defined.

pending.intrinsic-assignment-variable-defined: Initialize integer x to -777, execute x=123, and assert x==123; mutation deletes only the assignment.
pending.masked-forall-assignment-elements-define: Initialize integer a(4) to [-7,-8,-9,-10], execute WHERE([.true.,.false.,.true.,.false.]) a=[1,2,3,4], and assert a==[1,-8,3,-10].
pending.input-and-internal-write-variables-defin: For input, internal READ("456",*) into integer x initialized -777 and assert x==456; for internal WRITE, character record initialized "zzzz" receives "AB" and assertion checks record(1:2)=="AB".
pending.do-variable-defined: Initialize integer last=-777; DO i=1,3 assigns last=i each iteration, and assert last==3 after the loop.
pending.io-implied-do-variable-defined: Initialize integer i=-777 and array a=[1,2,3], execute internal WRITE(record,*) (a(i), i=1,3), then assert i==4 after successful completion; mutation changes the upper bound to 2 and expects final i==3.
pending.dummy-object-from-defined-effective-argu: Call subroutine with dummy lacking INTENT(OUT), actual integer initialized 246, copy dummy to result sentinel -777 inside the callee, and assert 246; repeat for a component subobject.
pending.iostat-variable-defined: Set ios=-777, perform successful internal READ with IOSTAT=ios, and assert ios==0.
pending.size-variable-defined-by-sync-input: Use formatted external nonadvancing input with a fixed two-character transfer and SIZE=sz, initialize sz=-777, and assert sz==2 under the registered SIZE= rules.
pending.async-input-size-defined-by-wait: Open a scratch external file for asynchronous formatted input, initialize sz=-777, issue asynchronous READ with SIZE=sz, WAIT for the id, and assert sz differs from -777 under the registered asynchronous I/O rules.
pending.inquire-assigned-variable-defined-no-err: Initialize logical opened=.false. and ios=-777, OPEN a scratch NEWUNIT, INQUIRE that connected unit with OPENED=opened and IOSTAT=ios, and assert ios==0 and opened==.true..
pending.iomsg-defined-on-io-condition: No portable oracle can force IOMSG text distinct from a sentinel; future evidence may only pair this with IOSTAT/IOMSG presence and avoid comparing message contents.
pending.associated-storage-units-defined: EQUIVALENCE two default integer scalars, seed one to -777, assign the other 909, and assert the first reads 909.
pending.complex-defines-partial-real: EQUIVALENCE default complex z with real r(2), seed r=[-7.0,-8.0], assign z=CMPLX(3.0,4.0), and assert r==[3.0,4.0] for exact small integers.
pending.complex-defined-after-parts-defined: EQUIVALENCE default complex z with real r(2), assign r=[5.0,6.0] after sentinel initialization, and assert REAL(z)==5.0 and AIMAG(z)==6.0.
pending.sequence-structure-defined-after-compone: Use numeric SEQUENCE type with two integer components equivalenced to integer view, assign both view elements [14,15], and assert the structure components read 14 and 15.
pending.stat-specifier-variable-defined: Initialize stat=-777, execute ALLOCATE(integer :: p, STAT=stat) for an unallocated allocatable, and assert stat==0.
pending.errmsg-defined-on-error: Allocate integer allocatable a, set msg to a long sentinel, execute ALLOCATE(a, STAT=stat, ERRMSG=msg), assert stat/=0, and record no comparison on msg text beyond source-status definition.
pending.allocated-zero-size-or-zero-length-defin: Allocate integer a(0) and character(len=0) c, initialize result sentinels to -777, pass both to INTENT(IN) checkers, and assert SIZE(a)==0 and LEN(c)==0.
pending.default-initialized-allocated-subcompone: Allocate an object with nonpointer component default x=77 without SOURCE=, initialize result sentinel to -777, and assert allocated%x==77.
pending.allocate-source-defined-subobject: Set source object components to [31,"R"], allocate allocatable object with SOURCE=source, and assert corresponding allocated subobjects equal [31,"R"].
pending.automatic-zero-size-or-zero-length-defin: Invoke a procedure with automatic integer a(n) using n=0 and character(len=n) c, set sentinels from SIZE(a) and LEN(c), and assert both zero.
pending.pointer-to-defined-target-defined: Set TARGET integer t=864, pointer p=>t, initialize result sentinel -777, and assert p==864.
pending.local-default-initialized-subcomponents-: Invoke a procedure declaring unsaved local type with component default x=42, copy local%x to result sentinel -777 before any assignment, and assert 42.
pending.intent-out-default-initialized-subcompon: Call subroutine with INTENT(OUT) dummy of type containing default component x=58, copy dummy%x to result sentinel before assignment, and assert 58.
pending.do-concurrent-forall-index-name-defined: Initialize array out=-777, execute DO CONCURRENT(i=1:3) out(i)=i, and assert out==[1,2,3]; FORALL companion uses index j to assign exact positions.
pending.local-init-defined-each-iteration: Use DO CONCURRENT with LOCAL_INIT(x), initialize a reduction array to -777 through x assignment in each iteration, and assert every iteration writes the initialized value specified by the registered locality rules.
pending.block-local-default-initialized-subcompo: Enter BLOCK with unsaved local type containing default component x=66, copy x to outer sentinel -777 before any local assignment, and assert 66 after the block copy.
pending.open-newunit-variable-defined: Initialize newunit_var=-777, OPEN(NEWUNIT=newunit_var,STATUS="SCRATCH",IOSTAT=ios), assert ios==0 and newunit_var differs from -777, then CLOSE it.

No doc/catalogues/19.5.2.2 owner exists on main in this worktree, so 19.6.8 carries its own concrete ASSOCIATED-status positive plans for pointer-association contexts rather than deferring to that missing owner.

requirements.title: External VOLATILE changes may make an object defined
requirements.definition: A VOLATILE object changed by means not specified by the program might become defined.

pending.volatile-external-change-might-define: No portable oracle can require an external volatile change not specified by the program; fixture plans may document processor-specific behavior only outside conformance credit.

requirements.title: Coarray and image-control definition events are out of execution scope here
requirements.definition: LOCK, UNLOCK, image failure, EVENT, FORM TEAM, and NOTIFY events cause the stated variables to become defined under their image-control semantics.

pending.lock-acquired-lock-variable-defined: Out of scope by user decision: LOCK with ACQUIRED_LOCK requires lock variables and image-control semantics.
pending.lock-without-acquired-lock-variable-defi: Out of scope by user decision: successful LOCK without ACQUIRED_LOCK is an image-control lock-variable facet.
pending.unlock-lock-variable-defined: Out of scope by user decision: successful UNLOCK is an image-control lock-variable facet.
pending.failed-image-lock-variable-defined: Out of scope by user decision: image failure and lock ownership across images are excluded.
pending.event-post-wait-variable-defined: Out of scope by user decision: EVENT POST and EVENT WAIT use coarray event variables.
pending.form-team-team-variable-defined: Out of scope by user decision: FORM TEAM and team variables are coarray/team facets.
pending.form-team-stat-failed-image-team-defined: Out of scope by user decision: STAT_FAILED_IMAGE on FORM TEAM depends on image failure/team semantics.
pending.notify-variable-defined: Out of scope by user decision: NOTIFY WAIT and NOTIFY= use notify variables and image-control semantics.

accounting.rationale: Thirty-seven definition events are split into fine units.

review_rationale: Source registration for 19.5.3 through 19.6.8: storage association, sequences and units, definition and undefinition events, and variable definition context and pointer association context (batch253). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across two rounds; undefinition is observed only where the standard preserves a value. Source accounting only.
